_comment: Define what demo content to capture for each beat. Stage 2 = manual user captures from logged-in browser session.
viewport: 540x960 portrait for video; landscape/full-canvas for screenshots

demos.capture_notes: Screenshot or screen recording of Stitch canvas showing 5 generated app screens from one prompt. Must show: 5 distinct screens with consistent fonts, colors, components. If video: show prompt → generation → 5 screens appearing. If screenshot: full canvas with all 5 screens clearly visible. Crop browser chrome.
demos.example_prompt: A fitness tracking app with dashboard, workout log, progress charts, profile, and settings screens
demos._note: HERO PROOF asset. The viewer must see 5 connected screens at once. This is the visual payoff for 'not one screen — FIVE connected screens'.

demos.capture_notes: Screenshot of the code export panel or dialog. Must show framework options: React, Tailwind CSS, Flutter, SwiftUI visible. If a code preview is visible, include it. Crop browser chrome.
demos._note: Proof that 'these aren't just mockups — it exports real code'. Framework names must be readable.

demos.capture_notes: Screenshot of Figma stock price chart (Google Finance or similar) showing decline around March 2026. Clean chart with clear downward trend visible. No personal portfolio data. Crop browser chrome.
demos._note: Hook support visual. Backs up 'Stop paying for Figma — Google just made it FREE'.

demos.capture_notes: Screenshot of Stitch sign-in page or pricing/usage indicator showing free access. Must show Google account sign-in or '350 generations' limit visible. No personal data. Crop browser chrome.
demos._note: Trust beat visual. Shows no paywall, no credit card — just Google account.
